summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K reporting completion of a private Rule 144A/Regulation S offering of $625.0 million 6.250% Senior Notes due 2032 and $625.0 million 6.625% Senior Notes due 2035, with guarantees. Net proceeds were approximately $1,236.0 million after discounts and expenses. Proceeds, plus cash on hand, will fund the previously announced Hennessy Automobile Companies dealership-asset acquisition; pending closing, proceeds repay revolver acquisition-line borrowings. Indentures name Computershare Trust Company, N.A. as trustee. This is routine debt financing tied to a prior deal, not itself a special situation; watch acquisition closing and leverage.
